Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Minor Innate Technique. Example technique for sorcerers and NPCs (GM approval).

As a bonus action for 1 Cursed Energy, you can encase yourself in a field of mathematical infinity costing 1 Cursed Energy at the start of your turn. When you are targeted by a weapon, spell, Cursed Energy attack roll or any saving throws from sources outside your body you roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, any attacks or spells made against you automatically fail to hit or harm you in any physical way. You can spend 1 Cursed Energy to automatically roll a 6 on an Infinity roll. When you take the Dodge action while Infinity is activated, you gain advantage on the d6 roll, and you can grant its benefits to any creatures within your reach.
